decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY that discards the submitted concept and records the required reference strategy; no additional update or removal is necessary.
Discarding and replacing the script does not change the commissioned video count, duration, commissioning stage, or conditional order for additional videos.
The source changes script and keyword direction but does not resolve or alter the visual-production method, prohibited methods, or existing footage-method ambiguity.
The source contains no decision about audio levels, mixing standards, or the unresolved audio specification.

The direct-hook requirement was already established by message 50, and message 51 does not necessarily change its directness, attention goal, or Indian-market fit; its more specific keyword instructions belong to the source Requirement.
The rejection of the submitted script does not modify the winning-creative objective or the below-50-INR cost-per-lead target.
